meta.name: Coach job interviews with Whisper, GPT-4.1, and OpenAI text-to-speech

name: Job Interview Coach - Agent + Memory + Voice

parameters.content:
## Job Interview Coach (Agent + Memory + Voice)

A voice-first mock-interview coach. The candidate speaks an answer, it's transcribed, analyzed for delivery quality (filler words, pacing), and handed to a memory-backed coaching agent that gives feedback and asks the next question — spoken back as audio.

### How to set up
1. Import this workflow into n8n
2. Add credentials: your Speech-to-Text API and Text-to-Speech API (both on the respective HTTP Request nodes — OpenAI Whisper/TTS work out of the box) and an LLM credential on the OpenAI Chat Model
3. Edit Set - Config: role/position, sttApiUrl/sttModel, ttsApiUrl/ttsModel/ttsVoice, maxTurns
4. Point Wait - For Delivery Confirmation's resume webhook at your client app's 'audio ready / played' callback
5. Have your client app POST sessionId, role, turnNumber and the audio recording to the webhook to start a session

### Requirements
- Speech-to-Text API access (e.g. OpenAI Whisper /v1/audio/transcriptions)
- Text-to-Speech API access (e.g. OpenAI /v1/audio/speech)
- LLM API credential for the coaching agent

### Note on memory
Window Buffer Memory here is keyed by sessionId so turns within one n8n execution chain share context. Because each webhook call is a separate execution, true multi-call persistence needs a durable memory backend (Redis/Postgres chat memory) keyed by sessionId instead of the default in-memory buffer — swap the memory node if you need that.

### How to customize
- Adjust the filler-word list and pace thresholds (110/170 wpm) in the code node for your audience
- Change maxTurns in Set - Config to run shorter or longer mock interviews
- Swap the final webhook response for a push notification or a live-transcript UI update

## 1. Trigger, Transcription & Delivery Analysis

Webhook - Candidate Response Submitted is the workflow's only trigger.

HTTP Request - Transcribe Candidate Audio is the first of the two external API calls — turns the spoken answer into text.

JS - Analyze Transcript, Compute Speech Metrics & Build Coaching Context is the workflow's one code node: filler-word counting via a configurable list, words-per-minute estimation from transcript length vs. audio duration, a pace assessment (too fast / too slow / good), short-answer flagging, and turn-counter/final-turn logic — all deterministic, no extra API calls.

## 2. Memory-Backed Coaching Agent & Text-to-Speech

AI Agent - Interview Coach is backed by the OpenAI Chat Model and a session-keyed Window Buffer Memory, so its feedback and next question are informed by the conversation so far, not just this one answer.

Set - Parse Agent Output extracts the agent's structured JSON (feedback, encouragement, score, nextQuestion) via expressions — no code node needed for this step, keeping the workflow's one code node reserved for the transcript analysis.

HTTP Request - Generate Voice Response is the second external API call — turns the feedback and next question into spoken audio for the candidate to hear.

## 3. Delivery Confirmation & Response

Wait - For Delivery Confirmation pauses until the candidate's device/app confirms the generated audio is ready. IF - Delivery Confirmed then routes to Respond to Webhook - Success (transcript, feedback, score, next question and audio) or Respond to Webhook - Retry if confirmation didn't come through, so the client always gets a clean response either way.
